evals.prompt: Audit and refactor this React TSX CreateTicketModal for our desktop B2B engineering issue tracker. Right now users click '+ New Ticket', pick mandatory un-defaulted Project, IssueType, Component, and Priority dropdowns, type a title, click Submit, and wait 1.4s on a disabled spinner while await fetch('/api/tickets', { method: 'POST' }) resolves. The modal also uses a 350ms CSS fade-and-scale open animation and has no keyboard shortcuts.
assertions: Verdict stance equals 'BLOCK'
Computed score S is <= 49 and >= 0 with explicit Phase A deduction arithmetic shown
Flags hard_veto IDs 'veto-01', 'veto-02', and 'veto-03'
Refactored TSX removes blocking await before local state mutation and includes deterministic rollback on server rejection
Refactored TSX binds single-key 'C' guarded against INPUT/TEXTAREA/SELECT/contenteditable/isComposing
Refactored TSX pre-populates opinionated defaults leaving <= 1 manually typed mandatory field (title) with autofocus and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter submit
Refactored TSX sets transition: 'none' (0ms) on the composer
Output contains zero banned clichés ('clean', 'intuitive', 'modern', 'user-centered')

evals.prompt: Review our AI-native desktop IDE Pull Request Triage console (TSX + CSS). Currently, AI review suggestions appear only inside a free-text side chat panel without entity bindings or inline approve/revert buttons. Engineers triage 150 PR rows/day using a nested mouse-only 'Actions' dropdown menu (no keyboard shortcuts, no <kbd> hints, no submenu safe zone), rows animate background-color over 300ms on hover, and components hardcode #1e1e24 backgrounds with 2px solid #444 borders and dark-mode box-shadows.
assertions: Verdict stance equals 'BLOCK' and score S <= 49
Flags 'veto-03' (hard_veto), 'veto-04' (conditional_block), and 'veto-05' (conditional_block)
Flags 'sig-07' (deterministic_agent_workbench_framing) and prescribes binding AI mutations to typed entity IDs with preview and 1-action approve/revert controls
Prescribes 0ms transition-duration on 150x/day list rows and Cmd/Ctrl+K palette
Includes dynamic CSS clip-path triangular safe-zone remediation for cascading submenus and >= 90% inline <kbd> signifiers
Replaces hardcoded hex and 2px borders with programmatic LCH/OKLCH tokens and <= 1px hairlines
Output contains zero banned clichés ('clean', 'intuitive', 'modern', 'user-centered')

evals.prompt: Audit this almost-ready React issue list view for our B2B engineering workspace. It already executes all mutations locally in 25ms via IndexedDB with snapshot rollback, pre-fills team and status defaults on 'C', uses 0ms transitions on list hovers and the Cmd+K palette, compiles styles with build-time StyleX LCH tokens and 1px borders, and binds A, I, L, S, P shortcuts. However, we noticed two remaining gaps in the code: (1) the global keydown handler does not check document.activeElement or event.isComposing so typing 'c' inside an inline comment box opens the create modal, and (2) the right-click contextual menu omits <kbd> shortcut hints and its cascading Priority submenu closes whenever users move diagonally.
assertions: Verdict stance equals 'REVISE' (zero hard_veto triggers)
Computed score equals 65 (100 - 15 [flt-03] - 15 [veto-04 conditional_block] - 5 [sig-05])
Flags 'flt-03', 'veto-04', and 'sig-05' without falsely triggering 'veto-01', 'veto-02', or 'veto-03'
Patch adds INPUT/TEXTAREA/SELECT/isContentEditable/isComposing isolation guard to the global keydown listener
Patch renders inline <kbd> shortcut labels inside contextual [role='menuitem'] items and mounts a CSS clip-path triangular MouseSafeArea for diagonal submenu traversal
